claim: The distance-constrained encoding solves r=9 (k=3, s=6), n=48 in seconds (Gates App. C, 'This encoding solves r=9, n=48 in seconds').
encoding: distance-constrained: presence bit g_beta + 3 label bits per nonzero syndrome (252 vars at s=6), Tseitin AND monomials + native XOR clauses for the degree-1..3 CH parities, exact cardinality n=48 (seqcounter). Control: D3 [[47,3,3]] pinned SAT before each timed solve.
summary: SAT in under 1 second on every run (0.1s single-threaded, 0.6s at 4 threads including thread startup), returning a [[48,3,3]] candidate with rank 9, dX=16, dZ=3.
